decisions.reason: After two years on the market and a prior decision to continue, the cloud contact centre service has accumulated sunk cost and strategic commitment as a direct extension of the firm's digital-transformation and hybrid-cloud direction, so management is likely to persist unless results clearly collapse.

The call number routing platform remains very close to the firm's core connectivity offer and was visibly launched as a standalone product, so accumulated commitment and strong portfolio fit make withdrawal within the coming year unlikely.
